items.q: because Dan Gaines and most of these fellows were gamblers, now, over to Dreamland --

ctx.x: Across the street. And he used to -- he had different people out trying to get me to work for him. And I got $17.50 a week. Oh, that was money, $17.50, and there's where I really made money, because Dan Gaines and most of these fellows were gamblers, now, over to Dreamland --
